landing.heroSub: Hourly monitoring of particulate matter and SO₂ in Copiapó, Paipote and Tierra Amarilla. The system crosses wind direction with industrial emission to anticipate episodes before they are declared.
landing.liveSubPanel: Same readout as the ICAP panel · CAMS / Open-Meteo
landing.liveAlertRest: SW wind rotates toward the urban sector with active smelter emission. Avoid outdoor physical activity in that window.
landing.liveFallback: API unavailable; showing a sample with the same panel thresholds.
landing.accessDesc: The same JWT entry as before: ICAP panel, dispersion, Paipote N/R/M and air modules.
landing.accessHint: Access by authorized account (Copiapó / METGO admin user).
landing.stationsDesc: Copiapó, Paipote and Tierra Amarilla share an airshed: what one emits affects the others depending on the day's wind.
landing.stCopiapoBody: Residential and commercial area, mainly exposed to urban dust and traffic resuspension.
landing.stPaipoteBody: Industrial sector, main focus of SO₂ and particulate matter from smelter activity.
landing.stTierraBody: Mixed mining-residential zone, sensitive to wind direction from Paipote.
landing.modulesDesc: Each module turns station data into a concrete action for the community and local authority.
landing.modDispBody: Projection of where the emission plume moves based on hourly wind direction and speed.
landing.modAlertBody: Notification when the projected AQI crosses Moderate, Alert, Pre-emergency or Emergency thresholds.
landing.modHistBody: Downloadable hourly record of each standard exceedance, with station, pollutant and duration.
landing.modRecBody: Differentiated messages for the general population, sensitive groups and schools.
landing.howDesc: Four steps from hourly data to the recommendation that reaches the community.
landing.step1Body: The three stations report PM10, PM2.5, SO₂, wind direction and speed every hour.
landing.step2Body: Projects where Paipote emission moves based on the next hours of wind.
landing.step3Body: When the projected index crosses Moderate or higher, notification happens before the episode.
landing.step4Body: Delivers the recommendation by group and keeps an episode record for authorities and community.
landing.faq1q: Which stations does METGO Copiapó cover?
landing.faq1a: Copiapó downtown, Paipote (site) and Tierra Amarilla, plus valley seed points in the panel.
landing.faq2a: Use Sign in with your authorized account (METGO JWT). After login you see the ICAP panel at /app.
landing.faq3q: What do I see after login?
landing.faq3a: ICAP panel, map, dispersion, Paipote operations, sounding, satellite, heat waves, forecast and history.
landing.ctaTitle: Know the air you breathe before it happens
landing.ctaSub: Access for neighbors, schools and agencies in Copiapó, Paipote and Tierra Amarilla.
